description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!

Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain "Brilliance or Nothing" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and "breaking" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the "click" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the "Stream Team" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and "elite" visual identity across all platforms.

Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and "breaking" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted "fellow degen" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Marketing Assistant | Social Media Content Creation | Remote | US B2B Tech Startup in Real Esta[...]
description:
Company Overview

Our client is a profitable SaaS company that has supported property managers for over a decade. With more than 20,000 active users and 100M+ inspection photos processed, the platform helps customers—from single landlords to large firms—save time and reduce stress with mobile inspections, automated reports, and AI-powered tools. The team of ~20 people is fully distributed and focused on steady growth and long-term value.

Your Role

You’ll help us show how zInspector fits into real property-management work. Most of what you make will be short videos, screen walkthroughs, carousels, and posts for social channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts) plus some email content.

You’ll work with our Marketing Director and use inputs like support questions, product updates, and common scenarios to explain when a feature is useful and what changes for a property manager when they use it.

You’ll :

  • Produce short videos, screen recordings, carousels, and posts that show when a feature matters and why
  • Use inputs from support, product notes, and example scenarios to create concrete explanations
  • Adapt one idea into multiple formats across social, YouTube Shorts, and email
  • Write short, clear captions and copy that link a specific problem to how zInspector helps

Keep visual style and language consistent across channels

Look at basic stats (views, watch time, clicks, comments) and share what seems worth repeating

Add finished assets to our internal library so other teams can reuse them

You Bring

  • You write in clear, simple language and get to the point
  • You’ve made short-form content before (social posts and / or simple videos—class projects are fine)
  • You’re comfortable recording your screen and doing basic edits (cuts, captions, trimming)
  • You can follow a content plan and ship work on a steady weekly rhythm
  • You’re curious about how property managers actually work and what slows them down
  • You’re organized and follow through on what you commit to
  • You can work a schedule that overlaps with our core hours

Bonus Points :

  • You’ve made how-to or tutorial-style content before
  • You’ve been around property management, real estate, or operations in any capacity
  • You’ve written short marketing-style copy or email-like content
  • You’ve used Canva or Figma (or are fine learning quickly)
  • You’ve had any exposure to SaaS or workflow tools

What’s Offered :

  • Part-time or full-time hours, depending on your current schedule
  • Mostly remote work, with optional time in our Davis office if you’re local
  • Hourly pay based on experience and availability
  • Direct work with the Marketing Director on real product content
  • A role focused on one product and one audience, not a mix of unrelated projects

Interview Process :

Online tests – short assessment and typing test

  1. Screening call
  2. Marketing challenge – one short social / video post plus a simple written version
  3. Interview with the Marketing Director
  4. Final interview with the CEO

Most candidates move through the process in about 1–2 weeks .

title: Senior Engineer - Asset Integrity and Maintenance
description:
Be the energy behind change. Join ABL Group.

ABL Group is a leading global independent energy and marine consultant working in energy and oceans to de‑risk and drive the energy transition across the renewables, maritime, and oil and gas sectors, offering the deepest pool of expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more than 300 locations globally.

Working as a key member of our Asset Integrity and Maintenance (AIM) team in Brazil, you will support our clients in developing and implementing asset management strategies. Your work will include field surveys, data collection, equipment verification, and criticality assessments to ensure our clients' reliability and integrity programmes are driven by risk‑based prioritisation and high‑quality master data.

What will you be doing?

  • Perform field surveys, walkdowns, tagging, data collection, and condition assessments to support CMMS development, and maintenance strategy work.
  • Verify equipment and spare parts onsite, assess warehouse stock, and identify critical spares to support operational readiness.
  • Participate in inspections, functional checks, documentation reviews, and compliance assessments to ensure accurate master data and criticality classifications.
  • Produce clear, accurate reports, registers, and client deliverables in line with AIM standards and timelines.
  • Maintain strong communication with project managers, clients, and suppliers to support effective coordination.
  • Identify and support implementation of improvements across maintenance, reliability, and integrity processes.
  • Contribute to maintenance strategy development (PM, PdM, CBM), BoM creation, job plan structuring, and criticality and hierarchy reviews within CMMS and EAM systems.
  • Assist with project planning by helping to define deliverables, schedules, and resource needs, and monitor progress to maintain alignment with expectations.
  • Support proposal development and provide technical input for contract discussions, including coordination with third‑party suppliers.
  • Provide guidance to junior staff during fieldwork when required.
  • Ensure all field activities comply with procedures, QHSE policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support project and operational requirements.

What are we looking for?

  • Educated to bachelor’s degree level in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Marine, Production, or related).
  • Formal training or practical experience with CMMS/EAM systems.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical field experience in maintenance, asset integrity, inspections, or offshore operations.
  • Solid understanding of maintenance engineering, asset integrity principles, and core reliability concepts (PM, PdM, CBM).
  • Ability to perform onsite equipment identification, verification, and data collection, and interpret P&IDs, datasheets, manuals, and engineering drawings.
  • Certifications in Asset Integrity, Reliability, or Maintenance Management (API, ISO 55000, RCM, FMEA) and offshore safety training (BOSIET/FOET or equivalent) are desirable.
  • Experience with CMMS builds, data migration, maintenance strategy development, or reliability analysis is desirable.

Further Information

This position will be based remotely in Salvador, Bahia, Brazil.

You must have the legal right to live and work in Brazil.

The job holder will be expected to undertake onshore and offshore client assignments.

The closing date for applications is Friday 13th February.

At ABL Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. As a global company, we believe that diversity drives innovation and inclusion strengthens our teams. We support flexible working, accessible environments, and employee wellbeing. Overview

Vaga para fisioterapeuta Adulto com pós-graduação em Fisioterapia hospitalar, UCI Adulto ou cárdio-respiratória, com no mínimo de dois anos de experiência na área. A vaga é assistencial, devendo o candidato estar apto para atendimento em UCI Adulto e Unidade de Internação adulto. A fisioterapia adulto dentro do planejamento estratégico fica no contexto do ecossistema no fluxo de envio de pacientes para o IBR. A fundação tem uma cultura de promoção de saúde e sustentabilidade. A equipe de Fisioterapia possui dez profissionais.

Responsabilidades

Atendimento assistencial em UCI Adulto e Unidade de Internação adulto. Profissional deve ser responsável, proativo, ter bom senso com relação ao convívio do coletivo.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Escolaridade: Graduação plena em Fisioterapia com pós-graduação / MBA completo em Fisioterapia.
  • Conhecimentos e habilidades: domínio de procedimentos, planejamento e produção, tratamento de imagens; uso de equipamentos e manuseio de instrumentos digitais; manuseio de equipamentos de terceiros; manutenção básica de equipamentos de terceiros.
  • Atitudes e comportamentos: boa comunicação, pró-atividade, simpatia, comprometimento.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de planejamento médico, hospitalar/clínicas e exames fisioterapêuticos; necessidade de fisioterapia hospitalar/UTI; residência médica concluída.

Participação em treinamentos

Participação em treinamentos institucionais.

Processo de seleção

  • Step 3: Entrevista com o RH
  • Step 4: Entrevista com o Gestor

Sobre a instituição

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

Responsibilities

Senior Data Engineer

This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.

Responsibilities

Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.

Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.

Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.

Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.

Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and / or implement new data solutions and processes.

Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied / maintained.

Accountable for

Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.

Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.

Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.

Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users / processors across the company.

Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.

Essential skills and experience

Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.

GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow

Hands on Java experience

Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud

Experience of ETL / ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.

Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.

Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.

Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.

Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management

Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.

Experience working in an e-commerce / retail market would be beneficial.

Preferred skills and experience

Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.

Able to establish what does / doesn't align to business / functional strategies / priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.

Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.

Embrace change with a positive outlook.

Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.

The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

You will have the independence to manage projects and the technical expertise to ship robust, secure, and scalable features in a fast-paced environment.

  • Collaborative R&D : Work with security researchers to translate complex offensive security workflows into automated, AI-driven features.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills.

  • Demonstrable experience building and architecting AI agents (using frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI, or similar agentic architectures).
  • Demonstrable experience with database systems, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, and AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Proficient understanding of secure coding best practices and cybersecurity considerations.
  • Ability to independently manage projects, tasks, and deadlines.
  • A quick learner who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can independently manage projects, tasks, and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in cybersecurity, specifically offensive security or penetration testing.

Why Join Us?

  • We offer competitive rates based on the applicant's location and seniority, aligned with current market benchmarks.
  • 2 weeks of paid holiday per year.
  • Work remotely with a flexible schedule, contributing significantly to meaningful cybersecurity solutions.
  • Join a fast-paced, innovative team passionate about cybersecurity and technology.
  • Opportunity to lead impactful projects independently and grow professionally in a dynamic environment.

Please submit your resume and a cover letter that addresses the questions below. Applications that do not include responses to these questions in the cover letter will not be considered.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854 Turing•Salvador, BR

Descrição da vaga

About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well‑defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding‑based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self‑contained, well‑defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute‑force solutions.

Required Qualifications

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).

Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation, including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R.
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix, Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams.

Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert‑level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi‑modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure‑based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand‑based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI‑driven analysis workflows (step‑by‑step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning

Perks of Freelancing With Turing

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting‑edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

Evaluation Process

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior/Lead Mobile Software Engineer , you will drive reliable, high-impact iOS and Android applications that support patients and practices at scale within a 3–4 month project . This role is essential to strengthening the stability, performance, and evolution of a modern mobile ecosystem in real-world healthcare use cases. You’ll work across the full mobile lifecycle, partnering closely with product, backend, and design teams while shaping engineering standards. The opportunity offers strong ownership, visible product impact, and meaningful influence in a focused, fast-moving engagement.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own and evolve patient and practice mobile applications, ensuring stability, performance, and delivery velocity.
  • Design and implement mobile features using Swift and Java/Kotlin aligned with business and user needs.
  • Lead technical design reviews covering mobile architecture, offline-first data flows, sync strategies, and security considerations.
  • Collaborate closely with backend, product, and design teams to define cohesive API contracts and end-to-end user experiences.
  • Implement and maintain automated testing strategies, including unit and UI tests, to ensure release readiness and code quality.
  • Own mobile CI/CD pipelines, including signing, provisioning, beta distribution, and app store submissions.
  • Profile and optimize app performance across memory usage, network efficiency, and rendering.
  • Integrate mobile apps with REST and GraphQL APIs, push notifications, deep links, and secure data handling mechanisms.
  • Implement analytics, logging, crash reporting, and feature flags to improve observability and reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor other engineers, promoting mobile best practices and consistency.
  • Initial project duration of 3–4 months , with the possibility of continuation on other projects.

MUST HAVES

  • 5+ years of professional mobile development experience with multiple shipped iOS and Android applications.
  • Strong expertise in iOS development using Swift , SwiftUI , and UIKit .
  • Solid Android development experience using Java and Kotlin .
  • Hands-on experience with iOS frameworks including networking, local storage, Combine, WebKit, and biometrics.
  • Hands-on experience with Android technologies such as Kotlin coroutines, Jetpack components, Retrofit, Material components, and Navigation.
  • Experience managing mobile dependencies and shared libraries using tools like SPM, CocoaPods, and Gradle.
  • Deep understanding of mobile architectural patterns such as MVVM, MVC, and MVI, including dependency injection and offline caching.
  • Experience building and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Proficiency with mobile CI/CD tools such as Fastlane, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
  • Strong background in automated testing using XCTest, Espresso, and unit testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with analytics, observability, and monitoring tools for mobile applications.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI assisted development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, and boilerplate generation.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience working in healthcare or regulated environments.
  • Experience owning mobile applications at scale with frequent releases.
  • Familiarity with feature flag systems and experimentation frameworks.
  • Interest in mentoring, interviewing, and influencing mobile engineering standards.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Appointment Setter- Salvador, Brazil
description:
ROLE DESCRIPTION

As an Appointment Setter, your primary responsibility is to generate and schedule appointments for the sales team or service providers within a company. You will be responsible for contacting potential clients or customers, promoting the company's products or services, and persuading them to agree to an appointment. Your role is crucial in initiating the sales or service process and ensuring a steady flow of qualified leads for the sales or service team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation: Utilize various lead sources such as cold calling, email campaigns, social media, and networking to identify potential clients or customers who may be interested in the company's offerings.
  • Cold Calling: Initiate outbound calls to prospects, engage them in conversation, and present compelling information about the company's products or services to generate interest and secure appointments.
  • Appointment Scheduling: Set up appointments for sales representatives or service providers by coordinating availability between prospects and the appropriate team members. Use software tools or a CRM system to manage and update appointment schedules accurately.
  • Relationship Building: Establish and maintain a positive and professional rapport with prospects to enhance the likelihood of securing appointments. Understand their needs, answer their queries, and address any concerns they may have.
  • Product / Service Knowledge: Develop a solid understanding of the company's products or services to effectively communicate their value propositions, features, and benefits to potential clients. Stay updated on product / service enhancements or modifications.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all communications, appointments set, and outcomes in a CRM or database. Generate reports summarizing appointment metrics, conversion rates, and other relevant data for performance evaluation.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with the sales or service team to align appointment schedules with their availability and provide them with necessary details about each appointment. Share insights or feedback gathered during interactions with prospects to enhance the overall sales / service process.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market changes. Seek opportunities to improve appointment setting techniques, scripts, and strategies to optimize lead generation and appointment conversion rates.

Requirements

  • 2-3 years Proven experience in appointment setting, telemarketing, sales, or customer service roles.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to engage prospects effectively and build relationships over the phone.
  • Persuasive and persistent with the ability to handle objections and rejection professionally.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage and prioritize multiple tasks and appointments efficiently.
  • Proficient in using CRM software or appointment scheduling tools.
  • Familiarity with sales processes and terminology.
  • Self-motivated and target-driven with a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to adapt to changing circumstances and work well in a team environment.

Additional Information

Set-up: Full-time, Remote

Schedule: Monday - Friday, for 7.5 Flexible working hours between 6am-6pm Eastern Standard Time Zone (EST)
